dataset.sample_method: stable feature-row hash modulo 100, threshold 15; applied only to development source sessions

holdout.status: frozen and untouched; no holdout rows were parsed or used for fitting, calibration, or scoring

split_rules.session_unit: complete source CSV capture session; CICIDS2017 source files have no Timestamp column
split_rules.development_test: for each family, every development source session containing that family is held out as test; those sessions are excluded from train and validation
split_rules.development_validation: one complete non-test source session is selected by GroupShuffleSplit using the recorded seed
split_rules.training: all other development sessions; held-out-family rows are removed from train and validation; scaling and thresholds use training/validation only
split_rules.unknown_test_population: target-family rows in that family’s reserved development test sessions
split_rules.known_test_population: non-target test rows whose labels occur in that fold’s training data; other unseen labels are excluded and counted

model_and_decision_policy.classifier: LightGBM multiclass with current repository class weights
model_and_decision_policy.detector: confidence-only open-set score (1 - maximum class probability)
model_and_decision_policy.feature_policy: session-invariant sanitization enabled; scaler fitted on training rows only
model_and_decision_policy.host_window_context: CICIDS source data has no timestamps; host-window features therefore remain zero in this baseline

bootstrap.per_seed: stratified row bootstrap of binary decisions with known/unknown/benign supports fixed
bootstrap.across_seeds: percentile bootstrap of seed-level metric means

metric_definitions.precision: unknown-family true positives divided by all unknown-review flags
metric_definitions.recall: unknown-family rows flagged for unknown review divided by all target-family test rows
metric_definitions.f1: harmonic mean of unknown-review precision and recall
metric_definitions.fpr: known-class test rows incorrectly flagged for unknown review divided by eligible known-class test rows
metric_definitions.benign_replay_false_alert_rate: BENIGN rows from held-out development capture sessions incorrectly flagged for unknown review divided by BENIGN rows in those sessions; this is an offline session replay metric, not a live-service replay run
metric_definitions.unknown_review_semantics: confidence-threshold rejection is a triage proxy for UNKNOWN_NOVEL review, not a confirmed attack verdict

split_integrity: passed; train/validation/test source groups are pairwise disjoint for every family and seed
